subject: Order Form commercial terms — net terms & tax clarifications
messages:
From: Samantha Chen <samantha.chen@betaforge.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Ortiz <m.ortiz@betaforge.io>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Betaforge redlines + VAT / net terms questions

Jonas / Steph — attaching our redline of the Order Form (Betaforge_Redline_OrderForm_v3.docx) and a forecast schedule. Two quick asks up front: 

1) Net terms: our procurement team prefers net 60, but we can consider net 45 with an early-pay cadence. Please confirm Redwood's furthest flexibility on net terms for a mid-market + pilot commit.

2) Taxes: Betaforge is US-headquartered but invoices for EU subsidiaries will be routed through an EU entity. We need clarification on VAT handling for cross-border invoices and whether Redwood can issue VAT invoices for EU-domiciled invoices. If you require VAT registration docs from us, let me know which forms.

Also, there's a suggested tweak to the minimum commitment schedule in section 2. Pricing team wants the first-quarter commit to be lowered by 20% to accommodate ramp. I've highlighted the cell in Revenue_Schedule_BF_v2.xlsx.

Can we set up a quick legal-to-legal sync tomorrow to run through the commercial redlines and get to a DocuSign timeline? If you prefer, we can accept some commercial points (e.g., a small early-payment discount) in exchange for a shorter net term.

Thanks,
Samantha Chen
Sr. Procurement Manager, Betaforge
Samantha.Chen@betaforge.io
Attachments: Betaforge_Redline_OrderForm_v3.docx (docx), Revenue_Schedule_BF_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Samantha Chen <samantha.chen@betaforge.io>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Betaforge redlines + VAT / net terms questions

Samantha — thanks for the redline and the schedule. Looping in Neha (finance) to handle the tax and invoicing specifics. A couple of quick notes from Redwood's side: 

• Net terms: Our standard enterprise offering is net 45 for reserved commitments. Net 60 is possible on a case-by-case basis with a credit review and a modest fee or a small commitment uplift. We generally prefer to avoid >60 to manage cashflow for dedicated capacity.

• Early-pay discount: We can offer 1.5% if invoices are paid within 15 days. That could be a trade for moving to net 45. Happy to confirm on a deal-level number if that helps the procurement team.

• VAT / EU invoicing: Neha — can you confirm whether Redwood can issue VAT invoices for EU-billed entities and what documentation we need from Betaforge (VAT reg, EU billing contact, billing address)?

• Minimum commit: I reviewed your spreadsheet — lowering the first-quarter commit by 20% is feasible if we spread the shortfall across Q2–Q4 and maintain the annual minimum. I'll propose a revised revenue schedule and attach.

If possible, let's do a 30-minute legal/finance call tomorrow 10:00am PT to walk through the redline live. Proposed attendees: Betaforge legal (Samantha), Betaforge finance (Michael), Redwood legal (Steph), Redwood finance (Neha), me for commercial context.

Next steps: I will prepare a marked-up revenue schedule and a short summary of the redline items we need legal to weigh in on (tax language, payment obligations, invoicing entity, and the minimum commit amendment).

Best,
Jonas Weber
Customer Success — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
Attachment: Proposed_Revenue_Schedule_Redwood_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Samantha Chen <samantha.chen@betaforge.io>, jonas_weber@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 16:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Betaforge redlines + VAT / net terms questions

Hi Samantha — quick finance checklist ahead of the call: 

1) Invoice entity / VAT: Redwood can issue EU VAT invoices if Betaforge provides the EU VAT registration number for the entity being billed and the local billing address. If Betaforge wants Redwood to route invoices to an EU subsidiary, please confirm which legal entity will sign the Order Form. We will need: VAT number (if EU), legal entity name, registered address, and billing email.

2) Tax forms for US payments: If Betaforge is a US taxpayer entity, provide a completed W-9. If the paying entity is non-US, we will need the appropriate W-8 series. This is required for our AP process and for any withholding considerations.

3) Net terms: We can accommodate net 60 with an approved credit hold and an additional 0.5% fee on the invoice amount (one-time uplift) OR alternatively agree net 45 with an early-payment discount of 1.5% for payments within 15 days. Either option requires sign-off from our revenue ops team. Which does Betaforge prefer?

4) Invoicing cadence: Redwood issues invoices monthly in arrears by default for hosting and reserved capacity. If Betaforge needs quarterly invoicing, we can discuss but it will shift the billing schedule and require a different payment guarantee (PO or letter of credit).

5) Attachments: please confirm the final revenue schedule by EOD today so we can produce a pro forma invoice for the first billing cycle.

Proposed call times tomorrow (PT): 10:00am (preferred), 11:30am, 2:00pm. Please let us know which works.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Samantha Chen <samantha.chen@betaforge.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Ortiz <m.ortiz@betaforge.io>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Betaforge redlines + VAT / net terms questions

Thanks, Jonas / Neha — 10:00am PT works for us. We prefer net 45 with the 1.5% early-payment discount as the negotiated trade-off. We'll attach the EU VAT registration for our EU billing entity and provide the W-9 for the US paying entity ahead of the call.

Michael will upload the final revenue schedule (I asked him to reflect the 20% first-quarter reduction and the backfilled quarters) and we'll share the DocuSign PowerForm link once Redwood sends the updated Order Form.

On the call we'll aim to: 1) confirm the billing entity and VAT wording, 2) accept the revised revenue schedule, 3) agree on net 45 + 1.5% discount, and 4) confirm a DocuSign timeline for signature (target: 1 week).

Looking forward to the call — please send a calendar invite and the proposed marked-up Order Form before 9:30am PT so our legal team can review quickly.

Best,
Samantha
